BrochureContent.Content:
An exceptional four-bedroom detached bungalow set on a beautifully landscaped private site within Campbell Court on Cairns Hill, Carraroe, Sligo. 

Upon entering, you are welcomed by an impressive entrance porch with striking stained-glass double doors leading to a bright and spacious reception hall featuring hardwood flooring and decorative ceiling coving. The accommodation is thoughtfully designed and includes two generous reception rooms, each enjoying attractive feature fireplaces and large picture windows overlooking the mature gardens.

The heart of the home is the spacious kitchen and dining area, fitted with an extensive range of units, integrated appliances and ample space for family dining and entertaining. A separate utility room, guest WC and home office provide excellent practicality.

There are four generous double bedrooms, all with built-in wardrobes, including a spacious master bedroom with fully tiled en-suite. The remaining bedrooms are bright and well presented, complemented by a large family bathroom.

Externally, the property enjoys beautifully maintained gardens with lawns, mature hedging, planting and paved patio areas, providing excellent privacy and ideal spaces for outdoor entertaining. A detached garage, currently incorporating a sound room, together with an additional garden shed, offers outstanding storage and workshop potential. A sweeping driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Located just minutes from Sligo Town Centre and all local amenities, this home offers the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living and everyday convenience, making it an ideal family residence.
